{{Quote|A ''quarter'' of the price?! What are you talking about? We had a ''deal''! You bought the ''last'' five! Full price!"''<br />"''Well, you've made ''this'' take too ''hot'', haven't you? I did warn you about playing the same trick too often, didn't I?|Cade Skywalker and Muz|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
'''Muz''', also known as "'''Muz the Fence'''," was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who owned a [[Muz's shop|shop]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[137 ABY]]. As a [[black marketeer]], Muz [[Merchant/Legends|fenced]] stolen goods and supplies. The former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]] sold five shipments of contraband to Muz before [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lun Rask]], a leader in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization, asked the Muun to find out who was preventing them from acquiring contraband from [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] shipping [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. After purchasing a shipment of [[M-40 light repeating blaster|blasters]] from Skywalker, Muz informed Rask that the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter was the one hindering their operations by taking the contraband they wished to acquire.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Advice I give for free&mdash;get out of Tatooine while the getting is good.|Muz|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
Muz was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. By [[137 ABY]], Muz operated a [[Muz's shop|store]] for [[Merchant/Legends|buying and selling]] illegally obtained items, such as armaments and other goods. The [[black marketeer]], nicknamed "Muz the Fence," purchased items from the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]], who sold five shipments of contraband to the Muun under the pseudonym [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Legacy 37" />

However, [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lun Rask]], who was a leader in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization, made contact to demand that Muz find out who was preventing his [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from stealing shipments from [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. Skywalker, who had recently obtained a shipment of [[M-40 light repeating blaster|Thunderbolt Mark 7 blasters]], attempted to sell them to Muz. The Muun refused to buy them for the full price, electing to purchase the lot for a quarter of the standard rate. Skywalker tried to intimidate Muz into buying the shipment at full price by firing his [[Rawk chopped special|blaster]] in the shop.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

However, Muz refused and gave Skywalker the same offer, minus the damages done to the shop. Muz warned Skywalker to leave Tatooine after the latter agreed to the price, then contacted Rask and informed him that Skywalker was the one hindering Black Sun's operations by obtaining the contraband the criminal organization wished to acquire.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This fellow&hellip;came to me, wanted me to fence some goods he had&hellip;ah&hellip;'acquired'. Having already received word from your illustrious self, I naturally refused. I assume there is a reward for supplying the fellow's name?|Muz, to Lun Rask|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
Muz had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore blue-colored [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with a red vest. The Muun was condescending to Cade Skywalker when the former Jedi attempted to sell his sixth shipment of contraband when there was too much attention on it, as well as refusing to negotiate with Skywalker on offering a lower price than in the past. However, Muz did make it a point to warn Skywalker about Black Sun's interest in locating the person hindering their operations. After the meeting, Muz told Rask about Skywalker's whereabouts and lied to the Vigo about buying the latest shipment from the former Jedi.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

==Behind the scenes==
Muz appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 37|thirty–seventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="Legacy 37" /> The issue was released on [[June 24]], [[2009]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54409/star_wars_legacy_2006_37|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #37}}</ref>
